notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Activate Plate Armor by paying {0}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Cowardice triggers, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
The ability from step 4 fizzles due to having no valid target.
Repeat.
